messages:
Anya: heads-up — noticed a spike in reconnects + token charges for a small set of users after yesterday's console rollout.
Greg: saw that on traces. reconnect backoff looked normal, but billing logs show duplicate token increments for resumed streams.
Shreya: do we have a repro? might be sampling/proxy layer dropping resume-id and making clients restart with new token.
Anya: minimal repro: open SSE, kill connection, resume within 5s -> server returns 204 but console increments meter twice. paste logs:
Anya: ```http
> POST /v1/streams/resume
> X-Resume-ID: r-abcdef
< 204 No Content\n"token_charged": true
```
Greg: hmm console sampling pipeline aggregates by trace-id. If the proxy strips resume header we lose idempotency key and replay looks like new session.
ConsoleUI: current rollout sampling is 10% for resume-counts, but billing path isn't sampled and still increments full. mismatch is expected.
Shreya: so mismatch between telemetry sampling and metering -> overcounting for sampled traces. We should attach resume-id to billing events upstream.
Greg: proposal: attach deterministic resume fingerprint to meter event, and drop increment when duplicate resume fingerprint within 30s.
Anya: can we add a guard in proxy to preserve X-Resume-ID header across retries? quick fix.
DeployBot: canary 34% -> paused (errors +1) — rolling back to 33% per policy.
Shreya: long-term: console should surface a 'resume dedupe' toggle in rollout flags. Also add alert when resume:mismatch ratio > 1.05.
Greg: created a tiny RFC in #docs (link) with design + pseudocode. will follow up with PR for proxy fix.
Anya: thanks — assigning to @Greg for proxy, @Shreya for meter changes. I'll open a dashboard card to show "resume_count vs unique_resume_fingerprint" for the next 48h. :eyes:
